description: In Manager.io (Northwind Traders business), create a new purchase invoice (bill from a supplier). Navigate to Purchase Invoices and click 'New Purchase Invoice'. Select an existing supplier (e.g., Exotic Liquids or any other Northwind supplier), set the invoice date to today, and add two line items: (1) Description: Office Supplies, Quantity: 1, Unit Price: 250.00; (2) Description: Shipping Boxes, Quantity: 100, Unit Price: 1.50. Enter a supplier reference number: SUP-2024-001. Save the invoice. Credentials: Username = administrator, Password = (leave empty).
